title: Made a 1:1 Diablo 2 Idle Game
author: rev01ver15
selftext: Well, except graphics of course. I tried to cram in everything accurately, all items, equipment, classes, skills, all acts, enemies, cube recipes, runes, there is even a cow level! Moo. Almost everything Diablo 2 into a 2D idle game.

comments.author: Ok-Investment4414
comments.body: :- / why a carbon copy clone and not a better version ? a this is where diablo fucked up version , an i wish they had this version . u dont have a game u got a bad prototype , so u cannot just say u have a game "Well, except graphics of course" this isnt torn or dnd we need graphics and u know better. Anyways gl

comments.author: randommmoso
comments.body:
why would you focus on pointless content before actually getting a gameplay worth sharing? Do you envisage anyone playing this in the current format? 

I know AI can just spit out endless classes, rules, content but IMHO you need a loop first and iterate on it before you add pointless filler.

This is totally backwards imho

replies.author: rev01ver15
replies.body: How can you tell there is no loop when you haven't played it yet?

replies.author: randommmoso
replies.body: because I can see your gameplay? it's literally recorded in the video you just shared?

replies.author: rev01ver15
replies.body: Hahaha, I don't think you have any idea what an IDLE game is. So if you watch a short video, you know the depths of the gameplay? You must be a genius.

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
Dude.

Even if the graphics were not laughably horrible and accompanied by Claude's default UI, do you genuinely think this approaches being Diablo 2's experience?
